children: Innovative Designs, Inc. (OTCQB: IVDN) has filed its fiscal third quarter financial report that continues a record revenue growth rate and extends profitability to eight trailing quarters. Revenues for the 3 month period ending July 31, 2026 reached $758,247. As of this date, IVDN has surpassed all total revenue for the 2025 fiscal year results.

Cash position strengthened to $873K with no long term or convertible debt on the books. The IVDN outstanding share count remains low at 38.5 million, reflecting management's commitment to shareholder value.

Additionally, Insultex® independent laboratory testing program contracted with BRC Laboratories, a qualified independent testing company, received documentation from Perry Johnson Laboratory Accreditation Inc. certifying the testing facility and procedures. BRC Laboratory, is now accredited in accordance with the recognized International Standard: (ISO/IEC:2017). The purpose of this program is to allow Insultex® to qualify for the requirements of a much wider range of building applications and projects of larger scale and scope with retailers and customers on every level of the national homebuilding industry.
Insultex House Wrap® meets or exceeds new building codes specifying continuous insulation and exterior R-Value requirements.

Innovative Designs, Inc. manufactures the Insultex House Wrap® and Arctic Armor® Line, under the "i.d.i.gear" label featuring INSULTEX®. Patented INSULTEX® is the thinnest, lightest and warmest insulator in the market today. For more information, please visit:
